title: Resume the same obligation
description: Host-wait and settled-mission continuation commands omit --test-machine. Simultaneous cases retain their declared driver and full host set. For single-host cases the scheduler recovers each platform’s host from execution leases and runs, including continuation sources; a new platform selects a fresh eligible host. Correction-ready commands also omit the pin; single-host scheduling follows each corrected case’s requirement replacement history to its failed attempt host.
